name: pear-desktop
description: Client for YouTube Music - including custom plugins

scripts.vite:inspect: pnpm clean && electron-vite build --mode development && pnpm exec serve .vite-inspect
scripts.clean: pnpm del-cli dist && pnpm del-cli pack && pnpm del-cli .vite-inspect
scripts.dist: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --win --mac --linux -p never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --linux -p never
scripts.dist:linux:deb-arm64: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --linux deb:arm64 -p never
scripts.dist:linux:rpm-arm64: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --linux rpm:arm64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 -p never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 -p never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --win -p never
scripts.dist:win:x64: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --win nsis-web:x64 -p never
scripts.release:linux: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --linux -p always -c.snap.publish=github
scripts.release:mac: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --mac -p always
scripts.release:win: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm electron-builder --win -p always
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
